name: Question 8
problem:
Given that the differential equation

$$
{x}^{2}{y}^{″}+15x{y}^{′}+49y=0
$$

has the general solution

$$
y={c}_{1}{x}^{-7}+{c}_{2}{x}^{-7}\operatorname{ln}⁡x,
$$

solve the initial value problem

$$
{x}^{2}{y}^{″}+15x{y}^{′}+49y=0,\,y(1)=1,\,{y}^{′}(1)=1,\,x>0.
$$

Question 8
?

Given that the differential equation

x2y″+15xy′+49y=0

has the general solution

y=c1x−7+c2x−7ln⁡x,

solve the initial value problem

x2y″+15xy′+49y=0,y(1)=1,y′(1)=1,x>0.

a
y(x)=2−8ln⁡xx7
b
 y(x)=1−6ln⁡xx7
c
y(x)=1+8ln⁡xx7
d
 y(x)=2−12ln⁡xx7
e
 y(x)=1+6ln⁡xx7
Submit
